title: MOCK: Targeted Medicine Plus Chemotherapy for HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
official_title: A Randomized Phase 2 Study (MOCK DATA) of a Targeted Medicine Added to Chemotherapy for HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
citation: Example Cancer Center (MOCK). A Randomized Phase 2 Study (MOCK DATA) of a Targeted Medicine Added to Chemotherapy for HER2-Positive Breast Cancer. ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT05000001. Last updated 2026-09-14. Available from: https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT05000001
brief_summary: This study compares a new targeted medicine added to standard chemotherapy with standard chemotherapy alone. People with HER2-positive breast cancer at Stage II or Stage III may take part. Participants receive treatment for about 1 year and are checked with scans and blood tests every 3 months. The main goal is to learn whether the new medicine helps more people stay free of cancer for longer. (MOCK DATA: this is fake text for development only.)
eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
* Adults aged 18 years or older
* Confirmed HER2-positive breast cancer, Stage II or Stage III
* ECOG performance status 0 or 1

Exclusion Criteria:
* Prior treatment with a HER2-targeted therapy
* Heart function (left ventricular ejection fraction) below 50%
* Pregnant or breastfeeding

overview.sentence: A Phase 2 study, now recruiting, for people ages 18 and older with Breast Cancer and HER2-Positive Breast Cancer. Run by Example Cancer Center (MOCK) at 2 sites (nearest: Springfield, IL — 12 mi).
